## Research status

**Technical owners.** 2 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Governed Model Training, Distributed Optimization, and Scaling](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/governed-model-training-distributed-optimization-and-scaling.html), [Learning–Compute Topology and Adaptive Process Architecture](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/learning-compute-topology-and-adaptive-process-architecture.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 3.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** If independent encoders cannot agree on useful topology identity, or matched-resource interventions show no explanatory, control, or outcome value, the layer should be narrowed.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
